description: This PHP source file defines the 'ValidateResponseChecksumResultMutator' class, which is a custom result mutator for AWS S3 SDK operations. It provides functionality to validate HTTP response checksums for S3 operations, ensuring data integrity by checking response checksums against calculated values.

classes.name: ValidateResponseChecksumResultMutator
classes.description: A final class implementing S3ResultMutator, designed to validate response checksums in S3 responses to ensure data integrity, utilizing checksum algorithms and handling validation logic based on response headers and SDK commands.
